articles.summary: WAILEA, Hawaii – T-Mobile may finally be ready to find a serious use for the millimeter wave (mmWave) spectrum it’s had stashed on a shelf. And it doesn’t involve phones. Instead, the carrier is now looking at using its mmWave holdings to upgrade its fixed-wireless service in high-demand areas, two T-Mobile executives said in an interview […]
articles.title: T-Mobile execs open a door to mmWave FWA
